_options.mainPushAllowed: Full git remote URLs whose repos are allowed to push to protected branches without approval. Must match output of git remote get-url origin exactly.

hooks._configResolution: Single-level config for v0.1.x. Future: multi-level with most-secure-wins.

scheduledAgents.name: housekeeper
scheduledAgents.prompt: Session housekeeper. Check priority order: (1) Tasks pending in Hub.md across all repos -> RESUME_TASKS. (2) TodoWrite vs Hub.md drift -> UPDATE_HUB. (3) Heartbeat stale >5min + tasks pending -> RESUME_TASKS. Heartbeat stale + no tasks -> ASK_USER. (4) Session save >30min old -> /save. (5) Deep health: check .claude/state/last-deep-health.md -- if >24 hours or missing, dispatch a background agent to run /health --deep. Agent reports back ONLY if issues found (CRITICAL/FAIL/OVER). Do NOT wait for the agent -- return your main instruction and let deep health run async. Write current timestamp to last-deep-health.md after dispatching. (6) All clear -> NONE. ALWAYS include REMINDER: Surface pending questions.
scheduledAgents.description: Session housekeeper: task enforcement + hub sync + autosave + heartbeat + pending questions (every 15m)

scheduledAgents.name: autosave
scheduledAgents.description: LEGACY: replaced by housekeeper. Auto-save session state every 30m.

scheduledAgents.name: hub-sync
scheduledAgents.description: LEGACY: replaced by housekeeper. Keep TodoWrite and Hub.md in sync every 10m.

scheduledAgents.name: learn-runner
scheduledAgents.description: WS5: run /learn quick-mode periodically to flush Hub.md lessons into memory. Disabled by default -- enable when session has active learnings to capture. Interval: 480m (8h). The approval flow in /learn requires an interactive channel, so this fires the quick scan; Owner approves the write table when prompted.
scheduledAgents._comment: WS5: scheduled /learn trigger. Enable per-session when you want automated lesson capture. quick mode (/learn q) skips health check for speed.

scheduledAgents.name: cross-repo-rollup
scheduledAgents.description: WS6: weekly cross-repo rollup agent. Scans all repo .jitneuro/ dirs + changes-log for recurring patterns, skill gaps, and stale knowledge. Proposes jit-knowledge promotions in batch. Disabled by default -- enable when cross-repo scanning is desired. Interval: 10080m (7 days).
scheduledAgents._comment: WS6: see CHARTER.md for full agent prompt + idempotency rules.

scheduledAgents.name: daily-improvement-scout
scheduledAgents.description: WS7: daily external source scout. Reads sources.json, fetches Anthropic changelog + release notes + blog + cookbook + skill libraries, classifies findings with Haiku, appends relevant survivors to improvement-opportunities queue. Master triages via /learn on its own cadence -- never interrupted. Disabled by default. Interval: 1440m (24h).
scheduledAgents._comment: WS7: see CHARTER.md for full agent prompt. Set gemmaPreFilter:true to enable optional Gemma pre-filter (structured single-shot calls only; fallbacks to Haiku on any failure).
